quest.title: Life Flows On (I)
quest.description: The water source near the winery has become bitter for no apparent reason. The Adventurers' Guild hopes for your cooperation in resolving this matter.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x5, Mora x50000

talks.objective: Go to the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild and talk to Katheryne

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. How have things been?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Has something strange happened again, Katheryne?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Compared to previous major incidents, this one is not the most peculiar. However, it is still quite serious, as it risks having a great impact on Mondstadt's economy.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Recently, the bodies of water near the winery have turned bitter without any warning. If this persists, Mondstadt's wine industry may be wiped out in just a few years.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: For more details, please speak with Connor at the winery.

talks.objective: Go to Dawn Winery and speak to Connor

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Are you the people sent by the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's us!

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Well, that's a relief. Now, as for the matter at hand — rather than listening to me explain it, you may as well experience it for yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: This is a bottle of water that we drew just recently. It is hygienic, don't worry — we've put it through its purification paces. Have a taste and see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, oh, Paimon wants some too, Paimon wants a try!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's take a sip...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Blergh! It's so bitter...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: This bitterness cannot be removed via conventional purification processes, so it's not an issue of the water's composition. I suspect it must be some mysterious elemental phenomenon.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: As such, this water can't be used to make wine at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must've been tough for the nearby fish as well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: We tried cooking some of the fish killed by the bitter water. All the food we made turned out bitter, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon... hadn't quite thought that far.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's the situation. If you're looking for somewhere to start, my gut tells me you should investigate northward. Additionally, I wonder if Liyue's Bishui River or the waters of Qingce Village have been affected...

talks.objective: Follow the body of water northwest and investigate

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there was something inside it...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Life-Form
dialogues.text: Endora... no water... dying...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Endora... Is that your name?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Bitterness... an enemy. It will kill... Endora.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, um, so what can we do to save you?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Need... sweet water. Must go to... spring.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora... need water to move. No water. Nowhere to go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are we going to get this thing to a spring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, we've got a bottle right here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it's bitter too, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora... can endure. But... not for long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we can't afford to hang around, then. Let's get to a fresh spring, and quick!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, it's kinda interesting how Endora was able to make it this far off the back of a Hydro Slime. Kinda like our relationship, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Water here... sweet. Endora finds... same species.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora and... same species, make the water sweet. Bitterness... Rhodeia's doing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Same species? Oh, that's right, doesn't Springvale have a legend of a spring fairy or something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But first things first, let's get rid of the bitter water from our bottle and refill it from the spring.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, hang on a moment, Endora, you can't just run out by yourself like that!

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: I am Endora. I am a Lochfolk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, that's right! This guy is supposed to be one of the real believers in the spring fairy's existence.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: You're the spitting image of her. Just a fair bit smaller.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora... still small! Endora... still learning.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Well, your appearance proves to me that she was real. It wasn't just a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: She is still here. Name... unknown. She will not answer Endora.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora... wants to talk to her. Can take a message. What do you want to say?

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: You're saying she's been here all this time? And you can give her a message for me?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Yes. Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: I'm so old now, I...

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Tell her I said hello.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: She said some... strange things. Endora does not understand.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: The stream... hmm... I did not understand. Asked, received no reply.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps your vocabulary could use a little more breadth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess the spring fairy must have her reasons for not wanting to meet us.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: I do not... understand. Lochfolk like to join together.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: She is... one mind. All alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because other creatures can't fit in with you.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Oh? Why not?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we'd drown for starters!

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: You are lonely... We love all... We love all people.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Rhodeia's gaze... near the Stone Gate! Small water animals. Her scouts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Water animals? We saw some Oceanid Creatures 'round here once, didn't we?

response.speaker: Endora
response.text: Powerful water... changes shape into animals. Very dangerous. But joining with them... we learn new things.

response.speaker: Endora
response.text: Take me there. Rhodeia is uneasy. Rhodeia... makes water bitter. Endora will learn to speak. Explain to her.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're saying that you can help us, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, it's worth a shot. We don't have any other clues, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: I have found something!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you're speaking fluently all of a sudden!

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: My grasp of language has expanded from merging with those Oceanid Creatures. I can now comprehend the message from Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: "The stream of life flows on." It's a little melancholic. A short but enigmatic poem. I don't understand it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you'll figure it out in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Endora still has much to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Endora
dialogues.text: Rhodeia has been going wild lately. I must face her, and perhaps we can solve the problem that way.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the water from Dragonspine or Springvale. The problem probably stems from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: She is real, after all. But why does she no longer speak?
